OUR PRACTICE AREAS

Legal Practice Across Criminal,
Constitutional & Civil Matters

R.K. Puri Law handles a broad range of litigation and advisory matters through a multidisciplinary team of advocates.

01

Criminal Litigation & Defence

Criminal defence, trial proceedings, criminal appeals and revisions before Sessions Courts and Rajasthan High Court. Scrutiny of charge sheets, cross-examination, and evidence marshalling.

Explore Criminal Law ↗
02

Bail & Anticipatory Bail

Regular bail, anticipatory bail, interim protection, and bail applications under special criminal statutes (NDPS, POCSO, PC Act). Legal submissions concerning custody and procedural compliance.

Explore Bail Practice ↗
03

Criminal Investigation Advisory

Investigation-related legal advice, scrutiny of police case records, evidence assessment, and procedural compliance analysis drawing on 35 years of police leadership.

Explore Investigation Advisory ↗
04

Constitutional & Writ Litigation

Writ petitions under Articles 226 and 227 before the Rajasthan High Court: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Certiorari, Prohibition, and Quo Warranto. Challenges to arbitrary administrative action.

Explore Writ Petitions ↗
05

Special Criminal Courts

Proceedings before Special NDPS Courts, Special POCSO Courts, Special Anti-Corruption / PC Act Courts, Special SC/ST Act Courts, Special CBI Courts, and Juvenile Justice Boards.

View Special Courts ↗
06

Civil Litigation & Dispute Resolution

Civil suits, property disputes, injunction applications, revenue and municipal law proceedings, and civil appeals handled by our experienced associate advocates.

07

Commercial, Banking & MSME Matters

Legal matters involving micro, small and medium enterprises, banking disputes, financial transactions, and debt recovery proceedings.

08

Cyber Law & Technology Offences

Legal advice and representation concerning cyber-related offences, digital evidence verification, data integrity, and technology disputes.

09

Consumer Protection & Negotiable Instruments

Cheque dishonour complaints under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act and representation before District and State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions.

10

Family & Matrimonial Law

Matrimonial disputes, maintenance proceedings, domestic violence matters, and custody disputes handled with professional sensitivity.

11

Corporate Law & Intellectual Property (IPR)

Selected corporate legal advisory, trademark, copyright, and intellectual property disputes involving rights, ownership, use, and enforcement.

12

Professional Support for Advocates

Independent case records review, trial strategy formulation, witness examination preparation, and forensic consultations for fellow advocates and law firms.
